note: Performance budgets for the CPU-bound hot paths. Each ceiling is a REGRESSION ALARM with generous headroom over the observed local median (≈3–6×), not a performance target — CI runners are slower and noisier than a dev box. The scaling ratio is machine-independent and is the primary signal: it catches an accidental O(n^2) regardless of hardware. Raise a ceiling only deliberately, with justification in the commit; investigate a breach before relaxing it.

claims.verify_corpus_pass_ms.what: Median wall time to tokenize every claim in the 316-entry corpus once (concreteTokens).

parsers.per_file_ms.what: Median wall time to parse one representative ~120-line TypeScript file (parseFile, embedded WASM).

parsers.scaling_ratio_2x.what: Median(parse 2N files) / Median(parse N files). Linear parsing ≈ 2.0; a breach signals super-linear work.
